mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, template_id AS templateId, template_snapshot AS templateSnapshot, simulation_snapshot AS simulationSnapshot, status, current_stage AS currentStage, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, revision, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, user_id, template_id, template_snapshot, simulation_snapshot, status, current_stage, error_code, error_message, revision, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateSnapshot}, #{simulationSnapshot}, #{status}, #{currentStage}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'RUNNING', current_stage = 'ASSET_CHECK', started_at = #{startedAt}, updated_at = #{startedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE task SET current_stage = #{nextStage}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = #{currentStage}
UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', current_stage = 'FINALIZE', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED',
current_stage = #{failedStage}, current_stage = NULL,
error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.template_id AS templateId, a.storage_key AS storageKey, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, a.width, a.height, a.sha256, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM task_asset ta JOIN asset a ON a.id = ta.asset_id WHERE ta.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ta.slot_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE task_step SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = #{message}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_step SET status = 'SKIPPED', finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = #{message}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
